subject: zoology
question_text: What is meant by osmotrophic nutrition?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.61, VSAQ 156). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Definition
lines: Osmotrophic nutrition is the mode of
nutrition in which an organism takes in
pre-digested food through its body wall from
steps.why: Two things make this mode different from every other one — the food is already digested, and it comes in through the body wall — and both must be in the sentence or the definition fits ordinary absorption.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the words pre-digested. Food taken in undigested is not osmotrophic nutrition.
Writing that the food enters through a mouth. It passes through the BODY WALL.
steps.memory_tip: Osmo is about soaking in through the wall; trophic is about food. Food soaked in through the wall.
steps.margin_note: One sentence. It must carry both pre-digested and body wall.

steps.label: Example

lines.text: Digested outside the body, absorbed inside

lines: They secrete enzymes on to dead and waste
material and break it down outside the body.
They then absorb the digested food through
steps.why: The example has to show WHERE the digestion happens, because outside-the-body digestion is what makes the food pre-digested by the time it is absorbed.
common_mistakes: Writing that the fungus swallows the food. It digests the food outside and then absorbs it.
Giving Amoeba as the example. Amoeba engulfs solid food, which is a different mode.
steps.memory_tip: Enzymes go out, digested food comes in. The digestion happens outside the fungus.
steps.margin_note: Name the example, then two lines: enzymes out, digested food in.

insider_note: The examiner looks for the two words pre-digested and body wall; a student who describes ordinary absorption without them loses the definition mark.
